subject: Q3 Renewal: reserved capacity + throughput guarantee proposal
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Kim <alex.kim@brightwave.health>, Procurement <procurement@brightwave.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Q3 renewal — reserved capacity + throughput guarantee proposal

Alex / procurement team,

Hope you had a good start to the year. As we discussed in last week’s renewal review, Brightwave’s current Dedicated committed pool is up for renewal on March 1. Based on your Q4 usage (attached) and the new classifiers you plan to roll out in Q2, we recommended adding an additional reserved pool of 4x A100-equivalent GPUs to support the higher steady-state throughput and reduce tail latency for the scheduled batch jobs.

Quick summary of the ask and proposed commercial changes: 
- Add 4 GPUs to your reserved pool (brings total reserved GPUs to 10)
- New committed term: 12 months (renewal effective 2026-03-01)
- Throughput guarantee: minimum pooled throughput of 1,200 tokens/sec (measured as sustained 5-minute average across the reserved pool)
- Burst window: up to 2,400 tokens/sec for 30s bursts, subject to capacity availability
- Remedies: service credit if SLO missed (draft language attached)

I attached a draft addendum that specifies the SLO measurement windows, the monitoring signals we use (token emission rate, CPU/GPU util, queue depth), and the proposed remediation (service credits capped at X% of the monthly committed fee). This is intentionally conservative as a starting point — we want to make sure the language is operationally measurable and acceptable to your legal/procurement team.

Next steps I propose: 
1) Confirm that the proposed committed GPUs and 1,200 tokens/sec pooled SLO look aligned with your Q3 roadmap.
2) Procurement/Legal to review the attached draft addendum and redline any changes — copying procurement here.
3) If acceptable, we’ll push the redlined addendum into DocuSign and target an execution by Feb 23 to ensure capacity provisioning the first week of March.

Attachments: Brightwave-ReservedPool-Throughput-Addendum-draft.pdf, usage_report_q4_2025.csv

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if you want to walk the SLO language line-by-line.

—
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Alex Kim <alex.kim@brightwave.health>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@brightwave.health>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Q3 renewal — reserved capacity + throughput guarantee proposal

Neha — thanks for the summary and the attachments. A few clarifying questions from our side before we loop legal: 

1) Tokens/sec semantics: is the 1,200 tokens/sec requirement a pooled measurement across the entire reserved pool (i.e., aggregated across all 10 GPUs) or per-GPU? We need to understand how that maps to our per-service throughput needs.
2) Measurement window and telemetry: what exact metrics would Redwood rely on for SLO measurement? We want to avoid "black-box" measurements.
3) Credits: the draft mentions a service credit but not a concrete cap or escalation path. Can you propose a clear credit schedule?
4) Burst capacity: if Brightwave requires sustained bursts beyond the 30s window, what are the options?

Procurement: please advise on any company-level constraints (PO lead time, master services agreement redlines).

If helpful, I can schedule a 30-minute call next week with engineering & procurement to walk through the numbers.

—Alex
Alex Kim
CTO, Brightwave Health
alex.kim@brightwave.health | +1 (617) 555-0104

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Internal — proposed SLO/redline for Brightwave addendum

Folks,

I’ve taken Alex’s feedback and drafted a tighter SLO and credit schedule. Key changes I suggest: 

- Clarify pooled measurement: define "Pooled Throughput" as the aggregate tokens emitted by all instances running in Brightwave's reserved pool, divided by wall-clock time; measured as a 5-minute rolling average.
- Measurement signals: expose the telemetry endpoints we’ll use (deployment-level token emission rate, per-instance GPU util, request queue depth) and commit to surfacing the raw metrics via a shared dashboard for the customer (read-only).
- Credit schedule (monthly): if pooled 5-minute average < 1,200 tokens/sec for > 30 combined minutes in a calendar month, credit = 5% of monthly reserved fees. If < 900 tokens/sec for > 60 combined minutes, credit = 15% of monthly reserved fees (capped at 30%).
- Operational exemptions: maintenance windows and announced major infra upgrades (we’ll provide 72-hour notice) excluded; force majeure language unchanged.
- Burst handling: allow 30s bursts at up to 2x pooled throughput; sustained bursts beyond 30s will be handled via short-term autoscale burst capacity (chargeable at the agreed burst rate) or rebalancing within a multi-region fallback pool.

I attached a redline (reserved-pool-slo-redline.docx) with inline language — this is where legal will likely iterate. Sergio: can you validate the monitoring endpoints and confirm that the 5-minute rolling average is something we can instrument and expose as read-only?

If everyone is good, I’ll send Alex a consolidated addendum with the credit table and DocuSign link.

—Marissa
Director, Customer Success, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Kim <alex.kim@brightwave.health>, Procurement <procurement@brightwave.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Q3 renewal — final addendum proposal & DocuSign link

Alex / Procurement — forwarding the internal redline and the consolidated proposal below. We’ve adjusted the language per your ask: pooled measurement, 5-minute rolling average, and a clear credit schedule. Key points (final):

- Reserved capacity: +4 A100-equivalent GPUs, 12-month commitment.
- SLO: pooled throughput >= 1,200 tokens/sec (5-minute rolling average). Measurement will be via deployment-level token emission metric; read-only dashboard access provided.
- Burst: up to 2,400 tokens/sec for 30s; sustained beyond that will use billable burst capacity or fallback options.
- Credit schedule: 5% credit for >30 min/month below 1,200; 15% credit for >60 min/month below 900; cap 30% of monthly fee.
- Exemptions: scheduled maintenance (72h notice), force majeure.

Action items: 
1) Procurement to confirm PO lead time and any required PO wording (please reply to this thread).
2) Alex — if this language is acceptable I’ll send the addendum via DocuSign (link below) and target signature by Feb 23 to allow provisioning first week of March.
3) Sergio / Infra: prep the dashboard share and a short runbook for how we’ll measure/alert on the pooled throughput SLO.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/brightwave/BW-391-addendum
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/8349
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-Brightwave-RNW

Thanks all — looping back when signed.

—
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
